description: Find noun clusters of four or more nouns and break them up with prepositions.

questions.prompt: What is the maximum number of nouns in an STE noun cluster?
questions.explanation: STE does not permit noun clusters of more than three nouns. Longer clusters are difficult to understand.

questions.prompt: Which phrase correctly breaks up 'engine oil pressure warning light'?
options: warning light for the engine oil pressure
questions.explanation: Put the main noun first and use a preposition: 'warning light for the engine oil pressure'. 'Engine oil pressure' has only three nouns.

questions.prompt: Tap all the words in the noun cluster that is too long:
questions.sentence: Replace the fuel pump filter cover gasket.
questions.approvedAlternative: Replace the gasket of the cover on the fuel pump filter.
questions.explanation: 'Fuel pump filter cover gasket' has five nouns. Use 'of' and 'on' to break it into groups of three nouns or fewer.

questions.prompt: Break up the noun cluster: 'Examine the cabin air duct clamp.'
questions.explanation: 'Cabin air duct clamp' has four nouns. Put the main noun 'clamp' first, then use 'on': 'the clamp on the cabin air duct'.

questions.prompt: Which sentence obeys the STE noun cluster rule?
options: Disconnect the battery charger output cable.
Disconnect the output cable from the battery charger.
Disconnect the battery charger output cable connector.
questions.explanation: 'Battery charger output cable' has four nouns. 'The output cable from the battery charger' breaks it up with a preposition.

questions.prompt: Edit this step to 20 words or fewer and break up the long noun cluster. Keep 'examine', 'spring', 'relief valve' and 'corrosion':
questions.initialText: In accordance with the maintenance manual, you must carefully examine the hydraulic system pressure relief valve spring for signs of corrosion damage before you install it again.
questions.explanation: Keep the step short and put the main noun first: 'Examine the spring of the pressure relief valve for corrosion before you install it.'
